questions.subject: English
questions.passage_text: Honeybees are some of the most hardworking insects in the world. They live in large groups called colonies. Inside a beehive, there are three types of bees: the Queen, the workers, and the drones. The Queen bee is the most important member because she lays all the eggs. The worker bees are all female, and they do all the chores. They fly from flower to flower to collect a sweet liquid called nectar. While moving, they also carry pollen on their legs, which helps plants grow fruits and seeds. This process is called pollination. Back at the hive, the workers turn the nectar into honey, which they store in tiny wax cells called a honeycomb. Bees communicate with each other by performing a special dance. This dance tells other bees exactly where to find the best flowers.
